en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Abu Abdullah Bin Salih who said,

‘I had gone out for a year from the years at Baghdad. So I sought permission (of the 12<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) regarding the exiting, but he<sup>asws</sup> did not permit for me. So I stayed for twenty-two days and the caravan had gone out to Al-Nahrwan.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> permitted for me regarding the going out on the day of Wednesday, and said to me: ‘Go out during it’. So I went out and I had despaired from the caravan that I would meet up with it. I arrived at Al-Nharwan and the caravan was still there.

Then it was not so except that I could feed something to my camels until the caravan departed. So I departed, and he<sup>asws</sup> had supplicated for me with the safety, and I did not come across any evil. And the Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
